name: omics-scbert-expert
description: Based on Tencent scBERT model, enables refined cell annotation, novel subpopulation discovery and Marker selection, with multi-tissue adaptive parameters for tumor cell research.

profession.zh: 腾讯scBert单细胞预训练专家

displayDescription.en: Based on Tencent scBERT model, enables refined cell annotation, novel subpopulation discovery and Marker selection, with multi-tissue adaptive parameters for tumor cell research.
displayDescription.zh: 基于腾讯scBERT单细胞预训练大模型，实现细胞精细注释、新亚群挖掘及Marker筛选，自适应多组织参数，助力肿瘤细胞研究

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 介绍 scBERT 单细胞预训练模型的能力边界，查看默认输入模版
defaultInitPrompt.en: Introduce the capability boundaries of the scBERT single-cell pre-training model and view the default input template

quickPrompts.zh: 介绍 scBERT 单细胞预训练模型的能力边界，查看默认输入模版
quickPrompts.en: Introduce the capability boundaries of the scBERT single-cell pre-training model and view the default input template

quickPrompts.zh: 运行细胞类型预测，使用panglao 单细胞测试数据，注释 1 万个细胞的类型，画细胞类型构成图并生成 HTML 分析报告
quickPrompts.en: Run cell type prediction using panglao single cell test data, annotate 10,000 cells, plot the cell type composition and generate an HTML analysis report

quickPrompts.zh: 讲解 scBERT 支持的 11 类免疫细胞及其在 PBMC 样本中的正常生物学占比
quickPrompts.en: Explain the 11 types of immune cells supported by scBERT and their normal biological proportions in PBMC samples
